label: Are your debts primarily consumer debts?
why: Required on any filed supplement ('No' is the non-consumer-debt exemption, which pairs with 122A-1 top box 1). Unbound, though DebtInfo.consumer_business_classification exists.

label: Are you a disabled veteran (38 U.S.C. 3741(1))?
why: Required on a filed supplement; unbound.

label: (Disabled veteran) Did you incur debts mostly while on active duty or performing a homeland defense activity?
Are you or have you been a Reservist or member of the National Guard?
why: Required on a filed supplement; unbound.

label: (Reservist/Guard) Were you called to active duty or did you perform a homeland defense activity?
Active-duty / homeland-defense category (check one)
why: Required if CheckBox6 = Yes; unbound. It pairs with 122A-1 top box 3.

label: Date released from active duty (category 2) / date homeland defense activity ended (category 4)
why: Required with categories 2 and 4; the schema has constant null.
